parameters.query:
SELECT
  count(*)::int AS requests,
  (count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'ok'))::int AS ok,
  (count(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'ok'))::int AS not_ok,
  count(DISTINCT visitor_hash)::int AS visitors,
  coalesce(round(avg(total_ms) FILTER (WHERE status = 'ok'))::int, 0) AS avg_ms,
  coalesce(round((avg(tokens_per_sec) FILTER (WHERE status = 'ok'))::numeric, 1)::float, 0) AS avg_tokens_per_sec,
  coalesce(sum((entity_counts->>'PERSON')::int), 0)::int AS persons_masked,
  coalesce(sum((entity_counts->>'ADDRESS')::int), 0)::int AS addresses_masked,
  coalesce(string_agg(DISTINCT status, ', ') FILTER (WHERE status <> 'ok'), 'none') AS problems
FROM usage_logs
WHERE created_at > now() - interval '24 hours';
